sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2015 · Book Q4.16
sourceIssues.issue: With crank radius r=0.20 m, rod length l=1 m and N=210 rpm, omega=21.991 rad/s. At theta=45 degrees, exact slider speed is r omega[sin theta+(r/l)sin theta cos theta/sqrt(1−(r/l)^2 sin^2 theta)]=3.554 m/s. None of 1.8,1.9,18,19 m/s matches. If “20 cm crank” were intended as the stroke, r=0.10 m gives 1.665 m/s. The printed book key also marks this item with an asterisk.

sourceIssues.title: GATE ME 2007 · Set 1 · Q73
sourceIssues.issue: The printed common statement gives 20 kW at 30 rev/s, module 5 mm and 20 pinion teeth. Pitch radius = 0.05 m; tangential force = 20000/(2π × 30 × 0.05) = 2122.07 N. Normal force = 2122.07/cos20° = 2258.28 N. None of the printed choices matches. Option C (225.80 N) would follow from 2 kW instead of 20 kW. Automatic scoring is disabled because the source data and options disagree.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2024 · Q71
sourceIssues.issue: The printed phrase “mass of 3 kN” uses a force unit. Interpreting it as weight gives m=3000/9.81 kg and I=m×1.6^2. The energy increase is I[(340×2pi/60)^2−(315×2pi/60)^2]/2=70.29 kJ. None of the listed choices matches. Interpreting 3 kN as 3000 kg gives 689.56 kJ, but that changes the stated unit. The inconsistent source is retained with this calculation rather than forced into an option.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2022 · Q28
sourceIssues.issue: The conventional descriptions make statements 1,2 and4 correct, while the spring-controlled gravity governor pivots are not on the moving sleeve as stated. No option gives 1,2,4. The publisher’s model solution also notes the missing combination and suggests A as a best fit; it is not an exact answer, so this item is excluded from automatic scoring.

sourceIssues.title: ESE Prelims 2023 · Q95
sourceIssues.issue: With total extreme-to-extreme pitch 10 degrees, angular amplitude is 5 degrees=pi/36 rad. Maximum pitch rate=(pi/36)(2pi/20)=0.027416 rad/s. I=8000×0.75^2=4500 kg m^2 and spin=188.496 rad/s give C=23254.7 N m. None of the options matches. Taking 10 degrees as the amplitude would instead give 46509.4 N m (C), but contradicts the printed total angular movement. Both interpretations are shown; automatic scoring is withheld.

sourceIssues.title: GATE ME 2006 | Theory of Machines Book Q7.18
sourceIssues.issue: Shared data: m=12.5 kg, k=1000 N/m, c=15 N s/m. Damping ratio=c/(2sqrt(km))=0.067082; logarithmic decrement=2pi zeta/sqrt(1−zeta^2)=0.42244. None of 1.35,1.32,0.68,0.66 agrees. The printed key is an asterisk. No automatic grade is assigned.

visualReview.method: All question crops visually inspected on contact sheets; focused source-page inspection for shared statements, split questions and figures; final original-paper trims reviewed again.

visualReview.sourceLimit: Some lettering in historical ESE right columns is faint or damaged in the original supplied scan; cropping cannot restore absent source pixels.

limitations: Mains references are independently derived self-review guidance, not official UPSC marking schemes.
Six printed questions have inconsistent or ambiguous data; their conditional answers are explained and excluded from automatic scoring.
Historical answer keys are attributed to the supplied solved books; they are not labelled official UPSC keys.
Questions with changed numerical data or different asks remain separate.
The two new subjects retain all existing seven-subject question identities and learning records.
